Subject: GCP co-sell: Wildfire Health opportunity heatmap + resource handoff

Hi Elena and team,

Thanks for taking this on — Wildfire Health (Sanjay Rao) is the most active mid-market opportunity in our Q2 pipeline where GCP co-sell would materially accelerate procurement and POC access. Attaching a lightweight opportunity heatmap and a draft co-sell playbook so we can align expectations before the joint review.

Quick context: Wildfire is evaluating an LLM-driven clinical triage flow and wants tight latency + private deployment options. We’ve completed a technical POC and the blocker now is procurement + GCP contract support. Our SDR has been hands-on; the deal is tracked in HubSpot WF-4872.

Asks for the joint sync (30 min):
- Confirm GCP co-sell intake status and next steps for marketplace/listing if required
- Identify who at Google will be the co-sell lead and any inbound credits or credits committee timeline
- Align on listing owner (Redwood vs. partner) and handoff plan for materials (docs, security checklist)

Attached: 20270407-wildfire-opps-heatmap.xlsx, cosell-playbook-wildfire-v1.docx, gcp-cosell-intake-form.pdf

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 4/13 10:00–10:30
- Wed 4/14 14:00–14:30
- Thu 4/15 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, happy to take a short Doodle or a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@google.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wildfirehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: Wildfire Health opportunity heatmap + resource handoff

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and the materials. I’m happy to run point from the GCP co-sell side for this opportunity.

Next steps from GCP:
1) Please complete the official GCP co-sell intake (I’ve attached a PDF export) — it helps us triage credits + partner resources faster.
2) I’ll loop in our Field Co-Sell Lead (internal) once the intake is in; typically we need the current SOW/POC objective and rough ARR estimate to prioritize.
3) Listing: if you plan to put a marketplace listing, we need the draft listing copy and an initial security summary (SOC 2 scope + data residency). If Redwood prefers GCP to host the listing on behalf of Wildfire, flag that now so we can evaluate marketplace timelines.

I can join the 4/14 slot at 14:00 PT. Vanessa, Karthik — would you prefer to prep any additional artifacts before the sync (technical doc, SAML diagram, procurement contact)?

Elena Morris
Partner Manager, Cloud Partnerships | Google Cloud
elena.morris@google.com
